report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis of deployment-caused checkout errors. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with ok results. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders at 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. The deployment record only proves version 1.0.0 exists. No current evidence establishes a bounded fault, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or failed traces showing actual checkout errors (logs excluded from context)
Metrics for checkout/payment/inventory services, not only order
Deployment records for checkout service and any version change timing
Evidence of error rate or latency regression aligned to a deployment event
